title: Every comparison table in a report to you has a gold-standard column
why: Your gripe, Oct 27 (iOS kit consultation): "in all these tables include like 'gold standard' so i can get an idea of whats going on as i'm such a noob".
note: Merged: batch PR #663 landed on main as 1733dac (PR #655 closed as replaced). The shiv-stylisms output style says a comparison table in a reply or report to you carries a gold-standard or target column. The reply judge checks it on every reply that holds a table (async Haiku, never blocks); the rule stays unmechanized because only a model can tell a comparison table. Notes: the table finder skips separators with 1 or 2 dashes per cell; every reply with a table costs one Haiku call (frequency unmeasured). Port: yes; the output style installs everywhere.
